summary: Eightco Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an amended and restated consulting agreement with Worldcoin Tower LLC, expanding its engagement from digital asset treasury to a broader strategic asset strategy including investment in emerging companies. The consultant will receive a fee of 1.00% per annum of assets under management, with potential milestone payments at AUM thresholds of $1B, $5B, and $10B. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is present. This is a routine service agreement update, not a change-of-control or strategic transaction.
